The third row of the input is [2,8,1], which in the output becomes the first row [1,8,2], but reversed? Wait, no. Original third row is 2,8,1. Output first row is 1,8,2. So maybe reversing the third row gives 1,8,2, which matches the output's first row. Then the first input row [2,2,1] becomes the third output row [1,2,2], which is reversed as well.
